items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: I never heard him play the whistle, I heard him play drums.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear Chinese? You know, Abby Foster played slide whistle?

Little Chinese? Yeah, with Celestines Band or anything? I never heard him play the whistle, I heard him play drums. Great cymbal beat, like the beat cymbal and tom-tom. But this boy used to really play that solo. He played a solo just like a man would on a trombone or something.
So what happened with the band? You went on up north with her?

items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: He led a band at the Tivoli in Mexico with Charlie Love, Deucin.

ctx.x: I'd like to run into him sometime and then I could be glad to go to his house too. He usually interviews people out at the homes of the musicians and it's a little bit noisy in here with all the traffic going by and the fire engines today.
Do you remember much about Frank Matthew? Frank Matthew? Yeah. He led a band at the Tivoli in Mexico with Charlie Love, Deucin.
Frank Goody. No, I don't know him. I know Bibb Matthews, Bill Matthews.
